Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.View.GUI

Class PickConnectionSceneController

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
it.polimi.ingsw.View.GUI.Gui
it.polimi.ingsw.View.GUI.PickConnectionSceneController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class PickConnectionSceneController extends Gui implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Controller for the connection type selection scene in the GUI. This class handles user interactions for choosing between RMI and Socket connections and entering the IP address.

  • Method Details

    • onContinueButton

      public void onContinueButton(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Handles the action when the continue button is clicked. It retrieves the selected connection option and the IP address, creates a new ClientController, and switches the scene to the nickname scene.
      Parameters:
      event - The action event triggered by the continue button.

    • getSelectedConnectionOption

      public String getSelectedConnectionOption()
      Retrieves the selected connection option (either "Socket" or "RMI").
      Returns:
      The selected connection option as a string.

    • getIpAddress

      public String getIpAddress()
      Retrieves the IP address entered by the user. If the input is "0", it returns "localhost".
      Returns:
      The IP address as a string.

    • onBackButton

      public void onBackButton(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Handles the action when the back button is clicked. It switches the scene back to the start scene.
      Parameters:
      event - The action event triggered by the back button.
